title: Acceptance-checker characterization
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $s,v$ be natural numbers. The acceptance checker for $N$, when given the nested pair encoding of $x$, the binary expansion of $v$, and the binary expansion of $s$, returns true if and only if that encoded string belongs to the language of encodings of accepting configurations of $N$ on input $x$ within window radius $s$ and with configuration code $v$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over Boolean symbols
